ValidationRule.description: Disallows Draw Owner on Maker Draw statuses from being the Checker
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(Previous_Maker__c = OwnerId , NOT($Setup.Setting__c.Bypass_Validation_Rules__c), OR(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Ready for Scattering"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "ICU Validation 1 Complete"), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "ICU Validation 2 Complete") ))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot validate the draw if you were the previous Owner. Please check with someone from your team and ensure a different user validates the draw.
